supports: Trade deals that bring manufacturing jobs back to the U.S.
opposes: Tariffs he says raise prices on groceries, cars and building materials
positions.quote: Get rid of irresponsible tariffs that are driving up prices on groceries, cars, building materials, and everyday goods — while fighting for trade deals that bring manufacturing jobs back to America.

source.title: Tom Suozzi's Five-Point American Affordability Plan (campaign site)

positions.impact: He would vote to roll back current tariffs, which could lower prices on imported goods. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: Keeping the tax credits that lower health insurance premiums
The WISH Act to make long-term care more affordable
positions.quote: Protect and strengthen the tax credits that lower your health insurance premiums, invest in prevention and primary care, and pass the WISH Act to make long-term care more affordable so seniors can stay in their homes.

source.title: Tom Suozzi's Five-Point American Affordability Plan (campaign site)

positions.impact: People who buy insurance through the ACA marketplace would be the most affected by the premium tax credits. Seniors and families paying for long-term care would be affected by the WISH Act.

opposes: Spending on the war with Iran
positions.quote: Stop pouring taxpayer money into a reckless war.

source.title: Tom Suozzi's Five-Point American Affordability Plan (campaign site)

positions.impact: He would vote against further funding for the war. Congress controls war funding, but the President directs military operations.

supports: Lower taxes for Long Island families
positions.quote: Tom will Reduce the tax burden on Long Island families and work to restore the full State and Local Tax (SALT) deduction.
positions.impact: A full SALT deduction would mainly lower federal taxes for homeowners in high-tax areas like Nassau and Queens. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: A comprehensive package of border security and immigration reforms
positions.quote: We need a comprehensive package of reforms to achieve border security and address the unsustainable influx of undocumented migrants.
positions.impact: He would back a single bill combining border enforcement with other immigration changes. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

supports: A woman's right to make her own health care decisions, including abortion
positions.quote: Tom will always fight to defend a woman's right to make her own healthcare decisions.
positions.impact: He would vote against new federal limits on abortion. Abortion access in New York is set mainly by state law.

supports: Crime reduction through intervention and prevention programs
positions.quote: Bringing down crime through common sense reforms centered on intervention and prevention so that people feel safe.
positions.impact: Expect support for federal grants to local violence-prevention and intervention programs. Day-to-day policing is run by local police departments.

positions.quote: Tom stands with the state of Israel and believes we must continue to strengthen Israel's regional security and combat anti-Israel bias.
positions.impact: He would likely vote for continued U.S. military and security aid to Israel. As one of 435 House members, they would vote and push for this in Congress; it would only become law with majorities in both chambers and the President's signature.

positions.quote: Climate change is real and requires bold solutions to leave a healthier and more sustainable world behind for future generations.
positions.impact: He would likely support federal clean-energy and emissions measures. The campaign site doesn't name specific bills.
